## Purpose
Package marker for `backend/agents`, the "kernel" — the folder-per-agent configuration and execution layer (loader, factory, registry, execution engine, capabilities). It carries only a docstring describing the package's contents and no code.

## Shape
- A module docstring listing the package's three named submodules: `loader.py` (reads/parses `AGENT.md` files), `factory.py` (composes system prompts and instantiates `DeepAgent`), and `registry.py` (pipeline-to-ID maps and `get_pipeline_agents()`).
- No imports, no `__all__`, no executable statements.

## Why this shape
No explicit rationale beyond documentation; it is a plain package marker whose docstring orients a reader to the kernel's key submodules before they dig into `loader.py`/`factory.py`/`registry.py` directly.
